name: gl-crosswarp
title: Crosswarp transition
description: The outgoing image zooms in while the incoming one zooms out into place, sweeping from right to left. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-crosswarp", duration }] }).
author: Eke Péter <peterekepeter@gmail.com>
